summary.rule: Use the visible scene and preceding actions to identify a unique target. A specific receiver, assembly base, exposed surface or object prepared by a prior action can disambiguate the target of the following pickup and use/placement. Keep distinct object transfers separate. A mere repeated noun, arbitrary spatial relation or generic tool pickup is insufficient.
summary.scope: All 6600 current annotation records screened. 65 relational candidates received new coarse scene inspection; this is not a new frame-by-frame review of all 6600.
